up: Retrieve the distinct molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL5727212. For each molecule, return its ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id) and preferred name (pref_name) from the molecule_dictionary table. The document is stored in the docs table; join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then join molecule_dictionary on molregno to obtain the molecule details.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727212';
